spellbook.finance/limitations: ManaPool does not provide an OAuth consent endpoint, so the seller must sign in to SpellBook Finance for this handoff.
Only the seller opens the returned page and pastes the mpat_ access token there. Never ask them to paste the token into chat.

The page prefills the SpellBook sign-in email as the ManaPool email and the saved return address as the tax address ManaPool needs for carts. With no saved return address it asks for one. If the ManaPool email differs, the seller clicks Change on the page to edit it.
The page stores the token encrypted after validating the account with ManaPool. Verify completion with spellbook_manapool_connection_status.

Give ManaPool's token page only as a fallback when the seller cannot find the link on the SpellBook page. It is https://manapool.com/seller/integrations/manapool-api. A signed-out visitor reaches ManaPool sign-in there, which also offers sign-up.

Becoming a ManaPool seller asks only for an email. The seller ticks I want to sell on Mana Pool, enters an email, and ManaPool then offers Create New Access Token. SpellBook refuses to connect an account whose payouts are off, so send a new seller to https://manapool.com/seller/payouts to turn payouts on before pasting the token.

The seller account needs payouts and singles selling turned on in ManaPool before the token can list anything. A new seller store can start in vacation mode, which hides singles from buyers. Before the first spellbook_manapool_sync_apply, tell the seller to turn off vacation mode in ManaPool settings.
The step-by-step guide for the seller is https://spellbook-finance.com/guides/manapool-connect-and-sync.

description: Get the SpellBook Finance page where the seller connects ManaPool, and guide them through it. Call spellbook_manapool_connection_status first. Save the seller's return address with spellbook_return_address_save before you hand over the link, because the page fills ManaPool's tax address from it. Hand the seller only this one link. The page itself links to ManaPool's token page, where a seller with no ManaPool account signs up first and then creates an access token starting mpat_. Tell them the SpellBook page already shows their email and return address, so they paste only the token. Call spellbook_manapool_connection_status after they finish. The agent never receives or submits the credential.
name: spellbook_manapool_connect_link
